# Source: Fragment of a Bowl

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Fragment of a Bowl
- **Artist / culture:** Byzantine Greece, Corinth or Asia Minor, Constantinople
- **Date:** mid 12th-early 13th century
- **Style:** byzantine
- **Classification:** fragment
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 92533
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/92533
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/a1573aa7-a626-2edf-a978-ba4f9b2def73/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Ceramic Design

## Extracted source palette

`#C8C8A8, #A89868, #887848, #685838, #888878, #A8A888, #D8D8C8, #484828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#362E1D`
- `surface`: `#4D4637`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C8C8A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#484828`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D4637`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C675A`
- `error`: `#C8C8A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `12.62:1`, surface `8.79:1`
- Variant contrast: `8.79:1`
- Control contrast: `11.43:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
